author: Inside Edition
description: Investigators in France announced Monday two Renoir paintings stolen last month from a French Riviera museum have been found hidden behind a wall in a Marseilles home. The paintings, "Portrait of Madame Colonna Romano and "Young Woman at the Well" are worth nearly $5 million. They were discovered thanks to crime scene DNA evidence.
title: 2 Stolen Renoir Paintings Found Inside Wall of Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Selma Blair has been arrested for allegedly punching a flight attendant on a delta flight and biting another crew member. The actress, who has been public about battling multiple sclerosis, also allegedly tried to open a cabin door. Air traffic controllers requested medical assistance. Blair's representative says she "experienced a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct. Upon landing, she received medical attention and is currently in stable condition."
title: Actress Selma Blair Arrested After Alleged Mid-Flight Outburst

author: Inside Edition
description: A man armed with only a garden hose is being hailed a hero. The gardener was starting work when he saw a house in flames. He ran to the front door and woke the sleeping homeowner,  who rounded up her dogs and ran. The gardener then grabbed a garden hose and trained it on the burning house. The cause of the fire is under investigation and authorities say an e-bike charging in the garage may have been the cause.
title: Gardener Hailed A Hero After Saving Woman From House Fire

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman was shocked when a police officer showed up at her door accusing her of stealing a package from a neighbor’s house. The cop insisted he had video of her driving in the area and taking the package. It turned out to be a case of mistaken identity. Across the nation, anger is growing over the use of flock cameras and privacy concerns.
title: Woman Says Police Used Flock Cameras To Falsely Accuse Her Of Theft

author: Inside Edition
description: Less than a year ago, 17-year-old Wyatt Anderson was paralyzed from the neck down following a freak basketball accident. He feared he would never walk again. He later underwent spinal fusion surgery, then months of intense rehab. After slowly learning to walk again, he set an ambitious goal to run the Chicago Marathon. On Sunday, he crossed the finish line with a time of three hours and 56 minutes.
title: Teen Runs Marathon Less Than 1 Year After Being Paralyzed From The Neck Down

author: Inside Edition
description: The White House has a new Press Secretary. President Trump appointed Katie Zacharia to the post over the weekend. She spoke with Fox News after the announcement. Zacharia is a conservative commentator and attorney who served as a communication advisor for Trump Media and Technology Group, which runs Truth Social. She replaces Karoline Leavitt, who resigned this summer. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Trump Announces New White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia

author: Inside Edition
description: A new, 6-part podcast series from "48 Hours" and Erin Moriarty explores the disturbing story behind a woman's 2022 murder. The dismembered remains of 40-year-old Mindi Kassotis were found in a wooded location near Savannah, Georgia. Suspicion soon fell on Mindi's husband Nick. Moriarty tells Inside Edition that when investigators tried to discover who Kassotis was, "that's when this whole story unravels."
title: Erin Moriarty And '48 Hours' Share Disturbing Case Of 'Woman In The Woods'

author: Inside Edition
description: The Secretary of Defense has announced the execution by military firing squad of convicted Ft. Hood mass shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed. That decision has ignited considerable blowback, and Hegseth is defending it. In 2009, Hasan opened fire at the military base, killing 13 people and injuring dozens more. His execution, scheduled for Dec. 3, will be the first military firing squad execution since 1945.
title: Debate Rages Over Whether Ft. Hood Shooter's Execution Should Be Livestreamed

author: Inside Edition
description: Women who experienced postpartum psychosis share their stories with Inside Edition Digital.
title: Lindsay Clancy Trial Put Postpartum Psychosis In The Spotlight #shorts
